mechanism: C_Automaton stores ENUM_TIMEFRAMES m_TF from the constructor (EA passes PERIOD_M5 in the demo) and uses that TF for iBars/indicator handles, deliberately independent of the supervisor chart period so changing the visible chart TF cannot retune or false-fire the sensing clock.

why_new_for_mis: Pins the sensing sample clock to a fixed TF so MIS sensors are not silently retimed when an operator changes chart period—operational sampling hygiene for any indicator stack.
quote: It is important that the automation system always works in a certain timeframe, regardless of what the supervisor sees. If you use the same timeframe which is visible to the supervisor, here in the automation class, we can make the EA accidentally trigger at inappropriate times.

mechanism: CheckTrigger only evaluates when iBars(NULL, m_TF) > m_nBars and m_Handle is valid; otherwise returns TRIGGER_NONE. Model-specific indicator math lives inside that gate (body empty in the common skeleton; filled per model). Timer-driven Triggers() calls CheckTrigger rather than OnTick.
data_needed: m_nBars baseline; iBars on m_TF; valid indicator handle; OnTimer → Triggers()
why_new_for_mis: Explicit new-bar sampling gate as the sole eligibility for signal computation—MIS can reuse this as a bar-close sensing cadence rather than tick-noisy evaluation.
quote: calculation will only be performed on a new bar; if there is no new bar, the calculation will be ignored. Also, the handle must point to something valid; otherwise nothing will be calculated.

why_new_for_mis: Session clock as a first-class eligibility gate before signal sensing—MIS can treat weekday windows as a coarse liquidity/session regime mask.

series_key: creating an ea that works automatically
mechanism: Static m_Memory ∈ {TRIGGER_NONE, TRIGGER_BUY, TRIGGER_SELL}. On TRIGGER_BUY: if memory was SELL close first; open buy only if memory ≠ BUY; then set memory BUY (symmetric for SELL). Blocks same-side re-entries and treats opposite trigger as a side-change event requiring flatten-then-flip.
data_needed: CheckTrigger eTrigger; static m_Memory; ToMarket / ClosePosition
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic; works with any model plugged into CheckTrigger; demo mentions 9-period EMA new-bar entries (logic deferred to next article)
why_new_for_mis: Discrete side-state machine turns repeated indicator fires into a single regime-change flip event—usable as an MIS change sensor on directional state rather than every bar signal.
quote: if (m_Memory == TRIGGER_SELL) ClosePosition(); if (m_Memory != TRIGGER_BUY) ToMarket(ORDER_TYPE_BUY); m_Memory = TRIGGER_BUY;
